# Positive rooted amalgamation and an arbitrary-core inverse

Read ROOTED_ORDERED_AMALGAMATION.md for the graph product, retained four-state representation, symmetric binary formula, complete finite inverse including zero-slope axes, and the literal20-vertex H462661 repair.

The same-session companion already publishes the general Hamilton-path, endpoint and two-bin amalgamation identities:

https://github.com/eliottcassidy2000/math/blob/6ed2d7a0f1e1bfb26b9cc865ddc9f35dd0ad4567/session197/lowcycle/root-amalgamation/ROOT_AMALGAMATION.md

The additional focus of this checkpoint is the nonnegative retained-state matrix, its rank/negative-minor guardrails, the arbitrary-root-core two-integer formula and its complete axis-sensitive inverse. Run python3 verify_rooted_ordered_amalgamation.py and its -O form. The only code imports are the previously frozen retained-root checker and its helper. The corresponding independent review and controls are in rooted-amalgamation-review/.

No ten-million bank, unrestricted coverage claim or unfinished strong-core reduction is included in this checkpoint. No navigation file is changed.
